The '''Kharzet system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kharzet III]].
